# Houston Superior Painting

> Residential and commercial painting contractor founded in 2019 by Juan Serra, headquartered in Cypress, TX, serving Greater Houston from five offices. Interior and exterior painting, cabinet refinishing, drywall repair, limewash and brick finishing, soft washing, wood rot repair and residential remodeling. Insured with $2M general liability plus workers' comp; proof of insurance available upon request and provided with approved project documents. Qualifying painting projects carry a 5-Year Written Workmanship Warranty; complete terms are in the approved estimate and project documents. Free written estimates, nothing due until you approve the estimate. Texas does not issue a statewide painting-contractor license.

Official website: https://houstonsuperiorpainting.com (the only official site; houstonsuperiorpaintingmagnoliatx.com is not ours)
Phone: (346) 594-5960
Email: info@houstonsuperiorpainting.com
Book an estimate: https://app.insightpaint.com/book/houston-superior
